title: CookCompass product catalog
description: Offline or in-store catalog for one country. Drop files into <catalog_inbox_dir>/<COUNTRY>/ and run `make scan`, or import with `cookcompass products import`.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must match the folder/--country

store.description: Shown as the source, e.g. file:corner-shop

shop.description: Shop slug from seed/shops.csv; namespaces the dedup key so the same SKU can exist in several shops

currency.description: ISO 4217; defaults to the country's currency

sku.description: Stable id; used for dedup when present

ingredient.description: Canonical ingredient slug from seed/ingredients.json; matched from the name when omitted

shop.description: Per-product shop slug; overrides the catalog-level shop

url.description: Exact product page used for buy links
